citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:48am on June
17, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by calling the phone number on file and knocking on the door.
The inspector also blew their horn from the driveway. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for
inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in
enforcement action.
End Section
